Author: Yodhrin13
Name: HousingMarketShopper
Description: Reads a furnishing list, finds the cheapest market listings across all worlds via Universalis, then automates navigation and purchase using Lifestream and vnavmesh.
Punchline: Automatically source and buy housing furnishings at the best cross-world price.
Changelog:
1.1.1
- Fix: buying multiple of the same item now buys successive listings directly (like clicking the next row manually) instead of refetching between each unit — fixes the case where it bought one, stalled, then rerouted to another world even though stock remained
- Fix: listing refresh after a purchase now reliably re-requests data (closes the results window first), with a full re-search fallback
